children: Jo-Jo Capital Canada Ltd. (TSX Venture Exchange:

"), announces that John Timmons has tendered his resignation as a director of the Company, effective September 23, 2026. Mr. Timmons has served as a director of the Company since November 2023 and has resigned in connection with a relocation.
The board and management team of Jo-Jo would like to sincerely thank Mr. Timmons for his contributions to the Company and wish him continued success.

Jo-Jo Capital Canada Ltd. is a Canada-based capital pool company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange. The principal business of the Company is the identification and evaluation of assets or businesses with a view to completing a qualifying transaction under the policies of the Exchange. Jo-Jo has not commenced commercial operations and has no assets other than cash.
